div.div: For questions that need Reel content the assistant plans the search, runs a hybrid search over the index, drops unsafe chunks, reranks with a cross-encoder, adds neighbouring chunks and decides if the evidence is enough. If not, it rewrites the query and tries again once.

text.tspan: For questions that need Reel content the assistant plans the search, runs a hybrid search over the index, drops unsafe chunks, reranks with a cross-encoder, adds neighbouring chunks
and decides if the evidence is enough. If not, it rewrites the query and tries again once.
